description.narrative: ImFact BV intends to have subsidiaries in various African jurisdictions through which they will provide working capital financing to SMEs by purchasing pooled receivables across various sector verticals (e.g., logistics, healthcare, manufacturing etc.)

activity-date.narrative: Preference shares are redeemable by the company at the option of the investor any time after the fifth anniversary at a price that will give the investor a minimum return of 6% in USD terms, net of all taxes and charges.

sector.narrative: ImFact intends to provide SMEs with off balance sheet working capital financing through a true sale of receivables. ImFact will purchase receivables from SMEs at 40% to 60% of the asset face value thereby shortening their cash conversion cycle and availing capital for growth.
